views.evidence: View union (src/state/app.svelte.ts) has no 'history'. Adding one needs View-union + App.svelte loaders[] + NAV[] edits = 3 coupled edits + a new lazy chunk.
views.default: Q-A → attach history as a SECTION inside the existing Import.svelte (view 'import', nav.analyse). Zero routing churn, single concern, reachable from Home + nav already.

store_collisions.DB_VERSION_bump: NONE — F5 is read-only over the existing 'games' store + the existing 'playedAt' index. Doctrine (additive, no bump) satisfied without exception.

behavioural_collisions.detail: Played games: id 'g:<epoch>' (Play.svelte:432). Imported games: id 'import:<W>-<B>-<hash>' (Import.svelte:80), stored in the SEPARATE importedGames store. getAllGames reads ONLY the 'games' store → returns played games, never imported. History of imported games (if wanted) is a SEPARATE read (db importedGames) — keep F5 scoped to PLAYED games (PL1) and DEFER an imported-games history unless trivially folded.

GameRecord.variant==='chess960' games ARE written to 'games'. They must show in history but the 'analyse' affordance must stay disabled for them (existing AP-960-4 / Play.svelte:625-629 rationale). History list reuses that guard.
